reporting_basis: SOLO / STANDALONE. Determined 2026-08-26 by matching the total assets this dataset records against the balance sheets in the bank's own annual report. Evidence: FY2023 total assets of 555,738m match the figure under this report's 'Balance Sheet' (solo) heading; 564,929m is the consolidated total. Re-confirmed 2026-08-26 against the FY2024 and FY2025 annual reports: both reports' own 'Five Year Performance' tables reproduce 555,738m for FY2023 identically (a solo-basis figure), and their FY2024/FY2025 columns (697,349m and 843,341m respectively) are drawn from the same solo-basis table, so basis is unchanged across the whole 2011-2025 series stored here.
notes: annual_reports/CITYBANK archive covers 2013-2025 (missing only 2011, 2012 detail; those two years have total-assets-only data recovered from later reports' comparative charts). City Bank's annual reports from FY2023 onward each publish an intra-year 'Quarterly Performance'/'Quarterly Performance Review' table within the annual report itself, giving real Q1/Q2/Q3 data without needing separate quarterly PDFs. As of 2026-08-26, the bank's public website has migrated from thecitybank.com (now 301-redirects) to citybankplc.com, a Next.js single-page app whose report-listing pages render client-side and are not scrapable by a plain HTTP fetch; the actual PDFs are served from a 'legacy' Laravel-based site at legacy.citybankplc.com/report/annualreports, which lists direct download links for every annual report back to 2013.

sources.period: restatement discrepancies found: FY2024 figures, own report vs FY2025 report's comparative column
sources.note: FY2024's own annual report (contemporaneous) vs the FY2025 annual report's FY2024 comparative column disagree on: Investments (133,644 vs 134,357, +713m), Total Assets (697,349 vs 698,062, +713m), Total Shareholders' Equity (45,818 vs 46,121, +303m), Total liabilities (651,531 vs 651,942, +411m), Net Interest Income (14,490 vs 14,742, +252m), Operating Income (39,536 vs 39,789, +253m), Operating Expenses (16,483 vs 16,736, +253m), Cost-to-Income Ratio (41.7% vs 42.1%). Operating Profit (23,053), Profit Before Tax (17,799), Profit After Tax (10,851), EPS (8.1), NAV/share (34.0), Deposits (514,204) and Loans (444,978) are identical in both reports. Interim-quarter cumulative figures for Q2 2024 and Q3 2024 show smaller reclassifications between Net Interest Income and Investment Income (BDT 52m and 76m respectively, opposite-signed, netting to zero at Operating Profit); Q3 2024 cumulative EPS also differs (3.2 as originally reported vs 2.8 in the FY2025 comparative column) while Q1/Q2/full-year 2024 EPS match exactly across both reports. Per the project's standing rule, the contemporaneous (FY2024 report's own) figures were kept in bank_financials/CITYBANK/quarterly/2024_Q1-Q4.json; the restated figures are recorded here and in each affected quarter's period_note, never silently averaged or overwritten.

sources.period: 2026 Q1/Q2 -- PRIMARY PDF INACCESSIBLE, thin DSE-sourced EPS-only record
sources.note: City Bank's own Q1 2026 and Half-Yearly 2026 unaudited financial statements PDFs could not be located or downloaded despite an extensive multi-route search: (1) legacy.citybankplc.com/report/financialstatements (this dataset's own source for City Bank's quarterly PDFs through 2021) has not been updated since 2021 and lists nothing for 2022-2026; the site's own nav only links an 'Annual Report' category now, suggesting the quarterly-filing category was deprecated on this CMS, not merely unindexed; (2) the bank's current site (citybankplc.com/reports, discovered via sitemap.xml since it isn't linked from legacy.citybankplc.com) is a client-side-rendered Next.js App Router page -- its server response and every JS chunk fetched were inspected for an embedded data payload or API route and none was found; the site returns HTTP 200 with an empty content shell to both a browser UA and a Googlebot UA; (3) dsebd.org and cse.com.bd company pages both explicitly state 'For detail financial statements, please visit company's website' / point back to the bank's own investor-relation URL, hosting no PDF themselves; (4) Wayback Machine CDX search for citybankplc.com found no capture of any 2025-2026 quarterly-statement PDF or 'city-bank-declares-its-Nth-quarter' press page (a URL pattern that exists for 2021-2022 quarters but was never archived for later years); (5) direct filename guessing against ~15 plausible URL patterns on both legacy.citybankplc.com/files/ and www.citybankplc.com/files/ all returned HTTP 404. What WAS recovered: DSE's own live 'Interim Financial Performance' disclosure table on dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=CITYBANK (a primary regulatory disclosure filed directly by the company, independent of the bank's own website) discloses Q1 2026 EPS 1.580, Q2-discrete EPS 1.630, H1-cumulative EPS 3.010, and period-end market prices (29.7, 32.0) -- recorded in quarterly/2026_Q1.json and 2026_Q2.json. DSE's table does not label Solo vs Consolidated; independent press coverage (The Business Standard for Q1: PAT ~Tk241cr, EPS Tk1.6; Prothom Alo/TBS for H1, citing an Aug-2026 earnings-disclosure webcast: CONSOLIDATED H1 PAT Tk526.69cr, CONSOLIDATED EPS Tk3.01, matching DSE's 3.010 almost exactly) suggests the DSE-disclosed EPS may be Consolidated rather than Solo (this dataset's City Bank series is otherwise Solo throughout) -- flagged as an unconfirmed-basis caveat, not resolved. No balance sheet or other income-statement line items were obtainable for either quarter. This should be re-attempted in a future session, ideally with a way to execute the current site's client-side JS or a more targeted search for where the bank now actually publishes its quarterly PDFs.
